items.q: two people that I remember were Bessie Smith and Louis Armstrong... We had a record of Louis Armstrong singing

ctx.x: home to sit down and play my piano. The first thing I'd do, I'd come in, and if I had some chores to do, I would get it over fast, homework or whatever, and I'd spend the rest of the evening, until I went to bed, banging this piano. Every day I'd gain a little more, I'd learn a little something else. I finally found out how I could put three of the keys together and get a different sound. There would always be a sound that I... It was like finding something that you were looking for and knew it was there or…

At the same time, we had this old gramophone in the house, which you manually wound it with a crank, and it had this dog sitting on it listening... It had a horn, and it was always called... I think it was a RCA Victor slogan or something, and it said 'His Master's Voice' on there. Anyway, older people would remember that. If not, you can always go down to the museum and find these things. But we had a few records. And two records that I remember were... Or not two records, but two people that I remember were…
